review_items.decision: Accept the separate non-cyclic Item 4B policy identity, exact digest, authority boundary, and rule that issue-2 mapping approval cannot approve this policy.

Accept the four explicit candidate bounds of 4096 for prepared transfer attempts, pending H2D contexts, pending D2H contexts, and H2D receipts per worker step; accept their two exact runtime-constant sources, require content-bound executable attestation for every capacity path and later joint admission, and do not derive any value from issue-2 authority or analogy.

Explicitly approve serialization_failure to include bounded prepared-transfer, pending-H2D, pending-D2H, and H2D-receipt admission failure while the real transfer continues unchanged. Pre-start capacity emits no new base pair or edge. Late receipt capacity retains immutable start/done and edges 1-2, emits no receipt or edge 3, never retracts or repairs records, consumes the exact profiler loss record_seq, and fails the affected formal trace closed.

Accept the minimum exact pending-context identity using base_preempted_event_id without aliases, the scheduler-to-worker sidecar, worker-to-EngineCore done-event receipt, and prohibition on request/time/stage-derived reconstruction.

Accept that all four capacity paths, a CPU test for late receipt failure preserving prior records while forbidding edge 3, terminal/preemption invalidation, bounded receipt transport, record_seq/loss accounting, close cleanup, conformance, complete configuration and joint admission are mandatory before activation and that these decisions do not activate communication or G1.

Bind the exact runtime implementation commit and attest that prepared, pending H2D, pending D2H, and receipt capacities, atomic consumption, sidecar/receipt paths, pre-start versus late-receipt failure timing, immutable prefix records, and serving fail-open behavior conform to the policy.

Attest the real profiler record_seq and loss ledger, all three mapping-assigned edge emitters, receipt deduplication, EngineCore admission handoff, terminal/preemption invalidation, and close cleanup with whole-trace CPU tests.

Accept default-off implementation, no producer-path file or logging-handler I/O, content-addressed conformance evidence, and the requirement for a later resolved configuration, joint admission, and separate runtime-activation authorization.
